name: Layerbase
line: Managed databases for SQL, key-value, vector search, and webhook queues.

free.text: 2 DBs, 5GB, 20 conns; sleep 15m idle/30m MySQL; archive 14d asleep, 7d unused

cells.regions: US East or EU West; region choice unclear
cells.selfhost: Yes, local CLI; paid license needed for commercial use

sql.math: $5 a month subscription, with no query meter. Whether the workload fits depends on conditions, and tax is extra.
An eligible Free project costs $0 a month within its rules. It goes to sleep (hibernates) and is not always available.

files.math: Layerbase does not provide file or object storage for apps.

jobs.math: The queue adds $0 on an eligible Free Valkey plan. But 10,000 jobs reach its history limit, and hosting for the receiver is extra.
